jd: Northwind Robotics is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer for our Fleet Services team. You will design and operate TypeScript/Node.js services that coordinate autonomous mobile robots across warehouses. Requirements: strong TypeScript and Node.js experience, solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL), and experience designing reliable distributed systems. Nice to have: gRPC, Kubernetes, and observability tooling. You will collaborate closely with robotics and SRE teams and communicate clearly in writing.

Site Reliability Engineer at Northwind Robotics. Own the reliability and observability of services that control physical machines. Requirements: Kubernetes, Linux, incident response experience, and comfort with on-call. Nice to have: Prometheus, Grafana, and infrastructure-as-code.
